verses.original: וַיָּ֡קָם אֶלְיָשִׁיב֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְאֶחָ֣יו הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וַיִּבְנוּ֙ אֶת־ שַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֔אן הֵ֣מָּה קִדְּשׁ֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֖ידוּ דַּלְתֹתָ֑יו וְעַד־ מִגְדַּ֤ל הַמֵּאָה֙ קִדְּשׁ֔וּהוּ עַ֖ד מִגְדַּ֥ל חֲנַנְאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām ’el·yā·šîḇ hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl wə·’e·ḥāw hak·kō·hă·nîm way·yiḇ·nū ’eṯ- ša·‘ar haṣ·ṣōn hêm·māh qid·də·šū·hū way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏū dal·ṯō·ṯāw wə·‘aḏ- miḡ·dal ham·mê·’āh qid·də·šū·hū ‘aḏ miḡ·dal ḥă·nan·’êl
verses.literal: At the Sheep Gate Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests began rebuilding They dedicated it and installed its doors After building as far as the Tower of the Hundred and the Tower of Hananel they dedicated the wall . . .
verses.literalPt: E LEVANTOU-SE Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote, com os seus irmãos, os sacerdotes, e reedificaram a porta das ovelhas, a qual consagraram; e levantaram as suas portas, e até à torre de Meá consagraram, e até à torre de Hananel.

verses.original: וְעַל־ יָד֥וֹ בָנ֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹס וְעַל־ יָד֣וֹ בָנָ֔ה זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־ אִמְרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- yā·ḏōw ḇā·nū ’an·šê yə·rē·ḥōs wə·‘al- yā·ḏōw ḇā·nāh zak·kūr ben- ’im·rî
verses.literal: The men of Jericho built . . . next to Eliashib and Zaccur son of Imri built next to them
verses.literalPt: E junto a ele edificaram os homens de Jericó; também ao seu lado edificou Zacur, filho de Imri.

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַדָּגִ֔ים בָּנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י הַסְּנָאָ֑ה הֵ֣מָּה קֵר֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֙ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעוּלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ša·‘ar had·dā·ḡîm bā·nū bə·nê has·sə·nā·’āh hêm·māh qê·rū·hū way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏū dal·ṯō·ṯāw man·‘ū·lāw ū·ḇə·rî·ḥāw
verses.literal: The Fish Gate was rebuilt by the sons of Hassenaah They laid its beams and installed its doors bolts and bars
verses.literalPt: E a porta do peixe edificaram os filhos de Hassenaá; a qual emadeiraram, e levantaram as suas portas com as suas fechaduras e os seus ferrolhos.

verses.original: וְעַל־ יָדָ֣ם הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְרֵמ֤וֹת בֶּן־ אוּרִיָּה֙ בֶּן־ הַקּ֔וֹץס וְעַל־ יָדָ֣ם הֶחֱזִ֔יק מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם בֶּן־ בֶּרֶכְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵ֑לס וְעַל־ יָדָ֣ם הֶֽחֱזִ֔יק צָד֖וֹק בֶּֽן־ בַּעֲנָֽא׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- yā·ḏām he·ḥĕ·zîq mə·rê·mō·wṯ ben- ’ū·rî·yāh ben- haq·qō·ṣs wə·‘al- yā·ḏām he·ḥĕ·zîq mə·šul·lām ben- be·reḵ·yāh ben- mə·šē·zaḇ·ʾē·ls wə·‘al- yā·ḏām he·ḥĕ·zîq ṣā·ḏō·wq ben- ba·‘ă·nā
verses.literal: Next to them Meremoth son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz made repairs Next to him Meshullam son of Berechiah the son of Meshezabel made repairs and next to him Zadok son of Baana made repairs as well
verses.literalPt: E ao seu lado reparou Meremote, filho de Urias, o filho de Coz; e ao seu lado reparou Mesulão, filho de Berequias, o filho de Mesezabeel; e ao seu lado reparou Zadoque, filho de Baana.

verses.original: וְעַל־ יָדָ֖ם הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ הַתְּקוֹעִ֑ים וְאַדִּֽירֵיהֶם֙ לֹא־ הֵבִ֣יאוּ צַוָּרָ֔ם בַּעֲבֹדַ֖ת אֲדֹנֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- yā·ḏām he·ḥĕ·zî·qū hat·tə·qō·w·‘îm wə·’ad·dî·rê·hem lō- hê·ḇî·’ū ṣaw·wā·rām ba·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ’ă·ḏō·nê·hem
verses.literal: Next to him the Tekoites made repairs but their nobles did not put their shoulders to the work under their supervisors
verses.literalPt: E ao seu lado repararam os tecoítas; porém os seus nobres não submeteram a cerviz ao serviço de seu senhor.

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הַיְשָׁנָ֜ה הֶחֱזִ֗יקוּ יֽוֹיָדָע֙ בֶּן־ פָּסֵ֔חַ וּמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם בֶּן־ בְּסֽוֹדְיָ֑ה הֵ֣מָּה קֵר֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֙ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו וּמַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ša·‘ar hay·šā·nāh he·ḥĕ·zî·qū yō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ben- pā·sê·aḥ ū·mə·šul·lām ben- bə·sō·wḏ·yāh hêm·māh qê·rū·hū way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏū dal·ṯō·ṯāw ū·man·‘u·lāw ū·ḇə·rî·ḥāw
verses.literal: The Jeshanah Gate was repaired by Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah They laid its beams and installed its doors bolts and bars
verses.literalPt: E a porta velha repararam-na Joiada, filho de Paséia, e Mesulão, filho de Besodias; estes a emadeiraram, e levantaram as suas portas com as suas fechaduras e os seus ferrolhos.

verses.original: וְעַל־ יָדָ֨ם הֶחֱזִ֜יק מְלַטְיָ֣ה הַגִּבְעֹנִ֗י וְיָדוֹן֙ הַמֵּרֹ֣נֹתִ֔י אַנְשֵׁ֥י גִבְע֖וֹן וְהַמִּצְפָּ֑ה לְכִסֵּ֕א פַּחַ֖ת עֵ֥בֶר הַנָּהָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- yā·ḏām he·ḥĕ·zîq mə·laṭ·yāh hag·giḇ·‘ō·nî wə·yā·ḏō·wn ham·mê·rō·nō·ṯî ’an·šê ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn wə·ham·miṣ·pāh lə·ḵis·sê pa·ḥaṯ ‘ê·ḇer han·nā·hār
verses.literal: Next to them repairs were made by Melatiah the Gibeonite Jadon the Meronothite and the men of Gibeon and Mizpah who were under the authority of the governor of the region west of the Euphrates
verses.literalPt: E ao seu lado repararam Melatias, o gibeonita, e Jadom, meronotita, homens de Gibeom e Mizpá, que pertenciam ao domínio do governador dalém do rio.

verses.original: עַל־ יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק עֻזִּיאֵ֤ל בֶּֽן־ חַרְהֲיָה֙ צֽוֹרְפִ֔יםס וְעַל־ יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֔יק חֲנַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ הָרַקָּחִ֑ים וַיַּֽעַזְבוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַ֖ד הַחוֹמָ֥ה הָרְחָבָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘al- yā·ḏōw he·ḥĕ·zîq ‘uz·zî·’êl ben- ḥar·hă·yāh ṣō·rə·p̄ī·ms wə·‘al- yā·ḏōw he·ḥĕ·zîq ḥă·nan·yāh ben- hā·raq·qā·ḥîm way·ya·‘az·ḇū yə·rū·šā·lim ‘aḏ ha·ḥō·w·māh hā·rə·ḥā·ḇāh
verses.literal: Next to them Uzziel son of Harhaiah one of the goldsmiths made repairs And next to him Hananiah one of the perfumers made repairs They fortified Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall
verses.literalPt: Ao seu lado reparou Uziel, filho de Haraías, um dos ourives; e ao seu lado reparou Hananias, filho de um dos boticários; e fortificaram a Jerusalém até ao muro largo.

verses.original: וְעַל־ יָדָ֤ם הֶחֱזִיק֙ רְפָיָ֣ה בֶן־ ח֔וּר שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֥לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- yā·ḏām he·ḥĕ·zîq rə·p̄ā·yāh ḇen- ḥūr śar ḥă·ṣî pe·leḵ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Next to them Rephaiah son of Hur ruler of a half-district . . . of Jerusalem made repairs
verses.literalPt: E ao seu lado reparou Refaías, filho de Hur, líder da metade de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וְעַל־ יָדָ֧ם הֶחֱזִ֛יק יְדָיָ֥ה בֶן־ חֲרוּמַ֖ף וְנֶ֣גֶד בֵּית֑וֹס וְעַל־ יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֔יק חַטּ֖וּשׁ בֶּן־ חֲשַׁבְנְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- yā·ḏām he·ḥĕ·zîq yə·ḏā·yāh ḇen- ḥă·rū·map̄ wə·ne·ḡeḏ bē·ṯōs wə·‘al- yā·ḏōw he·ḥĕ·zîq ḥaṭ·ṭūš ben- ḥă·šaḇ·nə·yāh
verses.literal: next to him Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house and next to him Hattush son of Hashabneiah made repairs
verses.literalPt: E ao seu lado reparou Jedaías, filho de Harumafe, e defronte de sua casa e ao seu lado reparou Hatus, filho de Hasabnéias.

verses.original: מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֗ית הֶחֱזִיק֙ מַלְכִּיָּ֣ה בֶן־ חָרִ֔ם וְחַשּׁ֖וּב בֶּן־ פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ת מִגְדַּ֥ל הַתַּנּוּרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: mid·dāh šê·nîṯ he·ḥĕ·zîq mal·kî·yāh ḇen- ḥā·rim wə·ḥaš·šūḇ ben- pa·ḥaṯ mō·w·’āḇ wə·’êṯ miḡ·dal hat·tan·nū·rîm
verses.literal: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-moab repaired another section as well as the Tower of the Ovens
verses.literalPt: A outra porção reparou Malquias, filho de Harim, e Hasube, filho de Paate-Moabe; como também a torre dos fornos.

verses.original: וְעַל־ יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק שַׁלּוּם֙ בֶּן־ הַלּוֹחֵ֔שׁ שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם ה֖וּא וּבְנוֹתָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- yā·ḏōw he·ḥĕ·zîq šal·lūm ben- hal·lō·w·ḥêš śar ḥă·ṣî pe·leḵ yə·rū·šā·lim hū ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: And next to them Shallum son of Hallohesh ruler of the other half-district . . . of Jerusalem made repairs with the help of his daughters
verses.literalPt: E ao seu lado reparou Sallum, filho de Haloés, líder da outra meia parte de Jerusalém, ele e suas filhas.

verses.original: אֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הַגַּ֜יְא הֶחֱזִ֣יק חָנוּן֮ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י זָנוֹחַ֒ הֵ֣מָּה בָנ֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֙ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָ֑יו וְאֶ֤לֶף אַמָּה֙ בַּחוֹמָ֔ה עַ֖ד שַׁ֥עַר הָשֲׁפֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ ša·‘ar hag·gay he·ḥĕ·zîq ḥā·nūn wə·yō·šə·ḇê zā·nō·w·aḥ hêm·māh ḇā·nū·hū way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏū dal·ṯō·ṯāw man·‘u·lāw ū·ḇə·rî·ḥāw wə·’e·lep̄ ’am·māh ba·ḥō·w·māh ‘aḏ ša·‘ar hā·šă·p̄ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The Valley Gate was repaired by Hanun and the residents of Zanoah They rebuilt it installed its doors bolts and bars and repaired a thousand cubits of the wall as far as the Dung Gate
verses.literalPt: A porta do vale reparou-a Hanum e os moradores de Zanoa; estes a edificaram, e lhe levantaram as portas com as suas fechaduras e os seus ferrolhos, como também mil côvados do muro, até a porta do monturo.

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת׀ שַׁ֣עַר הָאַשְׁפּ֗וֹת הֶחֱזִיק֙ מַלְכִּיָּ֣ה בֶן־ רֵכָ֔ב שַׂ֖ר פֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית־ הַכָּ֑רֶם ה֣וּא יִבְנֶ֔נּוּ וְיַעֲמִיד֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ša·‘ar hā·’aš·pō·wṯ he·ḥĕ·zîq mal·kî·yāh ḇen- rê·ḵāḇ śar pe·leḵ bêṯ- hak·kā·rem hū yiḇ·nen·nū wə·ya·‘ă·mîḏ dal·ṯō·ṯāw man·‘u·lāw ū·ḇə·rî·ḥāw
verses.literal: The Dung Gate was repaired by Malchijah son of Rechab ruler of the district of Beth-haccherem He rebuilt it and installed its doors bolts and bars
verses.literalPt: E a porta do monturo reparou-a Malquias, filho de Recabe, líder do distrito de Bete-Haquerem; este a edificou, e lhe levantou as portas com as suas fechaduras e os seus ferrolhos.

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הָעַ֜יִן הֶ֠חֱזִיק שַׁלּ֣וּן בֶּן־ כָּל־ חֹזֶה֮ שַׂ֣ר פֶּ֣לֶךְ הַמִּצְפָּה֒ ה֤וּא יִבְנֶ֙נּוּ֙ וִיטַֽלְלֶ֔נּוּ וְיַעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָ֑יו וְ֠אֵת חוֹמַ֞ת בְּרֵכַ֤ת הַשֶּׁ֙לַח֙ לְגַן־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְעַד־ הַֽמַּעֲל֔וֹת הַיּוֹרְד֖וֹת מֵעִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ša·‘ar hā·‘a·yin he·ḥĕ·zîq šal·lūn ben- kāl- ḥō·zeh śar pe·leḵ ham·miṣ·pāh hū yiḇ·nen·nū wî·ṭal·len·nū wə·ya·ʿă·mī·ḏū dal·ṯō·ṯāw man·‘u·lāw ū·ḇə·rî·ḥāw wə·’êṯ ḥō·w·maṯ bə·rê·ḵaṯ haš·še·laḥ lə·ḡan- ham·me·leḵ wə·‘aḏ- ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ hay·yō·wr·ḏō·wṯ mê·‘îr dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: The Fountain Gate was repaired by Shallun son of Col-hozeh ruler of the district of Mizpah He rebuilt it roofed it and installed its doors bolts and bars He also repaired the wall of the Pool of Shelah near the king’s garden as far as the stairs that descend from the City of David
verses.literalPt: E a porta da fonte reparou-a Salum, filho de Col-Hosé, líder do distrito de Mizpá; este a edificou, e a cobriu, e lhe levantou as portas com as suas fechaduras e os seus ferrolhos, como também o muro do tanque de Hasselá, ao pé do jardim do rei, e até aos degraus que descem da cidade de Davi.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֤יו הֶחֱזִיק֙ נְחֶמְיָ֣ה בֶן־ עַזְבּ֔וּק שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּֽית־ צ֑וּר עַד־ נֶ֙גֶד֙ קִבְרֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד וְעַד־ הַבְּרֵכָה֙ הָעֲשׂוּיָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד בֵּ֥ית הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·zîq nə·ḥem·yāh ḇen- ‘az·būq śar ḥă·ṣî pe·leḵ bêṯ- ṣūr ‘aḏ- ne·ḡeḏ qiḇ·rê ḏā·wîḏ wə·‘aḏ- hab·bə·rê·ḵāh hā·‘ă·śū·yāh wə·‘aḏ bêṯ hag·gib·bō·rîm
verses.literal: Beyond him Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruler of a half-district . . . of Beth-zur made repairs up to a point opposite the tombs of David as far as the artificial . . . pool and the House of the Mighty
verses.literalPt: Depois dele edificou Neemias, filho de Azbuque, líder da metade de Bete-Zur, até defronte dos sepulcros de Davi, até ao tanque artificial e até à casa dos valentes.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֛יו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם רְח֣וּם בֶּן־ בָּנִ֑י עַל־ יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק חֲשַׁבְיָ֛ה שַׂר־ חֲצִי־ פֶ֥לֶךְ קְעִילָ֖ה לְפִלְכּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·zî·qū hal·wî·yim rə·ḥūm ben- bā·nî ‘al- yā·ḏōw he·ḥĕ·zîq ḥă·šaḇ·yāh śar- ḥă·ṣî- p̄e·leḵ qə·‘î·lāh lə·p̄il·kōw
verses.literal: Next to him the Levites made repairs under Rehum son of Bani and next to him Hashabiah ruler of a half-district . . . of Keilah made repairs for his district
verses.literalPt: Depois dele repararam os levitas, Reum, filho de Bani; ao seu lado reparou Hasabias, líder da metade de Queila, no seu distrito.

verses.original: אַחֲרָיו֙ הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ אֲחֵיהֶ֔ם בַּוַּ֖י בֶּן־ חֵנָדָ֑ד שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֥לֶךְ קְעִילָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·zî·qū ’ă·ḥê·hem baw·way ben- ḥê·nā·ḏāḏ śar ḥă·ṣî pe·leḵ qə·‘î·lāh
verses.literal: Next to him their countrymen made repairs under Binnui son of Henadad ruler of the other half-district . . . of Keilah
verses.literalPt: Depois dele repararam seus irmãos, Bavai, filho de Henadade, líder da outra meia parte de Queila.

verses.original: וַיְחַזֵּ֨ק עַל־ יָד֜וֹ עֵ֧זֶר בֶּן־ יֵשׁ֛וּעַ שַׂ֥ר הַמִּצְפָּ֖ה מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִנֶּ֕גֶד עֲלֹ֥ת הַנֶּ֖שֶׁק הַמִּקְצֹֽעַ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḥaz·zêq ‘al- yā·ḏōw ‘ê·zer ben- yê·šū·a‘ śar ham·miṣ·pāh mid·dāh šê·nîṯ min·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ă·lōṯ han·ne·šeq ham·miq·ṣō·a‘
verses.literal: And next to him Ezer son of Jeshua ruler of Mizpah repaired another section opposite the ascent to the armory near the angle in the wall
verses.literalPt: Ao seu lado reparou Ezer, filho de Jesuá, líder de Mizpá, outra porção, defronte da subida à casa das armas, à esquina.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֨יו הֶחֱרָ֧ה הֶחֱזִ֛יק בָּר֥וּךְ בֶּן־ זַבַּי מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִן־ הַ֨מִּקְצ֔וֹעַ עַד־ פֶּ֙תַח֙ בֵּ֣ית אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַגָּדֽוֹל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·rāh he·ḥĕ·zîq bā·rūḵ ben- zab·bay mid·dāh šê·nîṯ min- ham·miq·ṣō·w·a‘ ‘aḏ- pe·ṯaḥ bêṯ ’el·yā·šîḇ hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: Next to him Baruch son of Zabbai diligently repaired another section from the angle to the doorway of the house of Eliashib the high priest
verses.literalPt: Depois dele reparou com grande ardor Baruque, filho de Zabai, outra medida, desde a esquina até à porta da casa de Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְרֵמ֧וֹת בֶּן־ אוּרִיָּ֛ה בֶּן־ הַקּ֖וֹץ מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִפֶּ֙תַח֙ בֵּ֣ית אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב וְעַד־ תַּכְלִ֖ית בֵּ֥ית אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·zîq mə·rê·mō·wṯ ben- ’ū·rî·yāh ben- haq·qō·wṣ mid·dāh šê·nîṯ mip·pe·ṯaḥ bêṯ ’el·yā·šîḇ wə·‘aḏ- taḵ·lîṯ bêṯ ’el·yā·šîḇ
verses.literal: Next to him Meremoth son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another section from the doorway of the house of Eliashib to the end of the house . . .
verses.literalPt: Depois dele reparou Meremote, filho de Urias, o filho de Coz, outra porção, desde a porta da casa de Eliasibe, até à extremidade da casa de Eliasibe.

verses.original: וְאַחֲרָ֛יו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַכִּכָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·zî·qū hak·kō·hă·nîm ’an·šê hak·kik·kār
verses.literal: And next to him the priests . . . from the surrounding area made repairs
verses.literalPt: E depois dele repararam os sacerdotes que habitavam na campina.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֨יו הֶחֱזִ֧יק בִּנְיָמִ֛ן וְחַשּׁ֖וּב נֶ֣גֶד בֵּיתָ֑םס אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק עֲזַרְיָ֧ה בֶן־ מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה בֶּן־ עֲנָֽנְיָ֖ה אֵ֥צֶל בֵּיתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·zîq bin·yā·min wə·ḥaš·šūḇ ne·ḡeḏ bē·ṯå̄·ms ’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·zîq ‘ă·zar·yāh ḇen- ma·‘ă·śê·yāh ben- ‘ă·nā·nə·yāh ’ê·ṣel bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Beyond them Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs in front of their house and next to them Azariah son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his house
verses.literalPt: Depois reparou Benjamim e Hasube, defronte da sua casa; depois dele reparou Azarias, filho de Maaséias, o filho de Ananias, junto à sua casa.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק בִּנּ֛וּי בֶּן־ חֵנָדָ֖ד מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִבֵּ֣ית עֲזַרְיָ֔ה עַד־ הַמִּקְצ֖וֹעַ וְעַד־ הַפִּנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·zîq bin·nui ben- ḥê·nā·ḏāḏ mid·dāh šê·nîṯ mib·bêṯ ‘ă·zar·yāh ‘aḏ- ham·miq·ṣō·w·a‘ wə·‘aḏ- hap·pin·nāh
verses.literal: After him Binnui son of Henadad repaired another section from the house of Azariah to the angle . . . and the corner
verses.literalPt: Depois dele reparou Binui, filho de Henadade, outra porção, desde a casa de Azarias até à esquina, e até ao canto.

verses.original: פָּלָ֣ל בֶּן־ אוּזַי֮ מִנֶּ֣גֶד הַמִּקְצוֹעַ֒ וְהַמִּגְדָּ֗ל הַיּוֹצֵא֙ מִבֵּ֤ית הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הָֽעֶלְי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָ֑ה אַחֲרָ֖יו פְּדָיָ֥ה בֶן־ פַּרְעֹֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: pā·lāl ben- ’ū·zay min·ne·ḡeḏ ham·miq·ṣō·w·a‘ wə·ham·miḡ·dāl hay·yō·w·ṣê mib·bêṯ ham·me·leḵ hā·‘el·yō·wn ’ă·šer la·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh ’a·ḥă·rāw pə·ḏā·yāh ḇen- par·‘ōš
verses.literal: and Palal son of Uzai made repairs opposite the angle and the tower that juts out from the upper palace of the king near the courtyard of the guard Next to him Pedaiah son of Parosh
verses.literalPt: Palal, filho de Uzai, reparou defronte da esquina, e a torre que sai da casa real superior, que está junto ao pátio da prisão; depois dele Pedaías, filho de Parós.

verses.original: וְהַ֨נְּתִינִ֔ים הָי֥וּ יֹשְׁבִ֖ים בָּעֹ֑פֶל עַ֠ד נֶ֜גֶד שַׁ֤עַר הַמַּ֙יִם֙ לַמִּזְרָ֔ח וְהַמִּגְדָּ֖ל הַיּוֹצֵֽא׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nə·ṯî·nîm hā·yū yō·šə·ḇîm bā·‘ō·p̄el ‘aḏ ne·ḡeḏ ša·‘ar ham·ma·yim lam·miz·rāḥ wə·ham·miḡ·dāl hay·yō·w·ṣê
verses.literal: and the temple servants . . . living on the hill of Ophel . . . made repairs opposite the Water Gate toward the east and the tower that juts out
verses.literalPt: E os servidores do templo que habitavam em Ofel, até defronte da porta das águas, para o oriente, e até à torre alta.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֛יו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַתְּקֹעִ֖ים מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִנֶּ֜גֶד הַמִּגְדָּ֤ל הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַיּוֹצֵ֔א וְעַ֖ד חוֹמַ֥ת הָעֹֽפֶל׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·zî·qū hat·tə·qō·‘îm mid·dāh šê·nîṯ min·ne·ḡeḏ ham·miḡ·dāl hag·gā·ḏō·wl hay·yō·w·ṣê wə·‘aḏ ḥō·w·maṯ hā·‘ō·p̄el
verses.literal: And next to them the Tekoites repaired another section from a point opposite the great tower that juts out to the wall of Ophel
verses.literalPt: Depois repararam os tecoítas outra porção, defronte da torre grande e alta, e até ao muro de Ofel.

verses.original: מֵעַ֣ל׀ שַׁ֣עַר הַסּוּסִ֗ים הֶחֱזִ֙יקוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אִ֖ישׁ לְנֶ֥גֶד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: mê·‘al ša·‘ar has·sū·sîm he·ḥĕ·zî·qū hak·kō·hă·nîm ’îš lə·ne·ḡeḏ bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Above the Horse Gate each of the priests made repairs in front of his own house
verses.literalPt: Desde acima da porta dos cavalos repararam os sacerdotes, cada um defronte da sua casa.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֧יו הֶחֱזִ֛יק צָד֥וֹק בֶּן־ אִמֵּ֖ר נֶ֣גֶד בֵּית֑וֹס וְאַחֲרָ֤יו הֶחֱזִיק֙ שְׁמַֽעְיָ֣ה בֶן־ שְׁכַנְיָ֔ה שֹׁמֵ֖ר שַׁ֥עַר הַמִּזְרָֽח׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·zîq ṣā·ḏō·wq ben- ’im·mêr ne·ḡeḏ bē·ṯōs wə·’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·zîq šə·ma‘·yāh ḇen- šə·ḵan·yāh šō·mêr ša·‘ar ham·miz·rāḥ
verses.literal: Next to them Zadok son of Immer made repairs opposite his house and next to him Shemaiah son of Shecaniah the guard of the East Gate made repairs
verses.literalPt: Depois deles reparou Zadoque, filho de Imer, defronte da sua casa; e depois dele reparou Semaías, filho de Secanias, guarda da porta oriental.

verses.original: אַחֲרַי הֶחֱזִ֜יק חֲנַנְיָ֣ה בֶן־ שֶׁלֶמְיָ֗ה וְחָנ֧וּן בֶּן־ צָלָ֛ף הַשִּׁשִּׁ֖י מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑יס אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְשֻׁלָּם֙ בֶּן־ בֶּ֣רֶכְיָ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד נִשְׁכָּתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ʾa·ḥă·ray he·ḥĕ·zîq ḥă·nan·yāh ḇen- še·lem·yāh wə·ḥā·nūn ben- ṣā·lāp̄ haš·šiš·šî mid·dāh šē·nīs ’a·ḥă·rāw he·ḥĕ·zîq mə·šul·lām ben- be·reḵ·yāh ne·ḡeḏ niš·kā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Next to him Hananiah son of Shelemiah as well as Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph repaired another section Next to them Meshullam son of Berechiah made repairs opposite his own quarters
verses.literalPt: Depois dele reparou Hananias, filho de Selemias, e Hanum, filho de Zalafe, o sexto, outra porção; depois dele reparou Mesulão, filho de Berequias, defronte da sua câmara.

verses.original: אַחֲרֵי הֶחֱזִ֗יק מַלְכִּיָּה֙ בֶּן־ הַצֹּ֣רְפִ֔י עַד־ בֵּ֥ית הַנְּתִינִ֖ים וְהָרֹכְלִ֑ים נֶ֚גֶד שַׁ֣עַר הַמִּפְקָ֔ד וְעַ֖ד עֲלִיַּ֥ת הַפִּנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ʾa·ḥă·rē he·ḥĕ·zîq mal·kî·yāh ben- haṣ·ṣō·rə·p̄î ‘aḏ- bêṯ han·nə·ṯî·nîm wə·hā·rō·ḵə·lîm ne·ḡeḏ ša·‘ar ham·mip̄·qāḏ wə·‘aḏ ‘ă·lî·yaṯ hap·pin·nāh
verses.literal: Next to him Malchijah one of the goldsmiths . . . made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants opposite the Inspection Gate and as far as the upper room above the corner
verses.literalPt: Depois dele reparou Malquias, filho de um ourives, até à casa dos servidores do templo e mercadores, defronte da porta de Mifcade, e até à câmara do canto.

verses.original: וּבֵ֨ין עֲלִיַּ֤ת הַפִּנָּה֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֔אן הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַצֹּרְפִ֖ים וְהָרֹכְלִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇên ‘ă·lî·yaṯ hap·pin·nāh lə·ša·‘ar haṣ·ṣōn he·ḥĕ·zî·qū haṣ·ṣō·rə·p̄îm wə·hā·rō·ḵə·lîm
verses.literal: And between the upper room above the corner and the Sheep Gate the goldsmiths and merchants made repairs
verses.literalPt: E entre a câmara do canto e a porta das ovelhas, repararam os ourives e os mercadores.
